parsedVerdict.reasoning: ProductsController is a thin HTTP primary adapter. Its responsibilities are all transport concerns: routing (@Get/@Post/@Patch/@Delete), parameter parsing (ParseIntPipe, @Body, @Query), HTTP status codes (@HttpCode), OpenAPI documentation (@ApiOperation/@ApiResponse), declarative access-control decorators (@RequirePermissions, @OptionalAuth), and resolving the caller context. Every handler delegates straight to an injected use case's execute(). The controller holds no business rules: the 'only active products for shoppers' rule appears only in Swagger description text and is passed to the use case through the caller context. It also has no persistence logic. The one piece of shaping is in update(), which spreads the id into the DTO ({ id, ...updateProductDto }). That is plain input mapping, which is a normal adapter job. All of these responsibilities fit the infrastructure (transport adapter) layer.
